name: Fen Runner Nell

intro.text: When the washes freeze, every fen village comes out on the ice. My great-gran won a leg of mutton racing here. I'm after the mutton. Race me!

win: Fell through. Metaphorically. The ice is fine.
after: Fen runners have long, flat blades fixed to your boots. Lean low, swing your arms, and never, ever look at the swans.
